lastCompletedStory.title: Deterministic spec writer specifyIssueOnMain (promote idea->specified on main)

nextStoryContext: US-003 created src/commands/issue-specify.ts with specifyIssueOnMain(). It mirrors issue-file.ts commit-tree-to-main plumbing: reads backlog via git show main:scripts/cam/issues.local.json, validates spec (validateSpec from spec.ts) and wsjf (validateWsjf from spec.ts) before reading backlog (fail fast), guards target id exists and stage=idea and status=open, mutates in-memory, runs checkReferentialIntegrity on post-mutation backlog, serializes, and commits on-main or off-main via commit-tree plumbing. Commit msg: chore(cam): specify <id>. Exports SpawnFn, ClockFn, SpecifyIssueOnMainOptions, SpecifyIssueOnMainResult, SpecifyIssueOnMainError, SpecifyIssueOnMainOutcome. 22 tests pass (unit + real-git integration). 1784 total tests pass, typecheck clean, biome lint clean.
